items.title: AutoZone Q4 Earnings Beat Estimates on Tariff Refunds, Sales Miss
items.summary: AutoZone (AZO) reported strong fiscal Q4 2026 earnings per share of $56.05, surpassing estimates due to tariff refunds and gross margin expansion, despite sales of $6.60 billion falling short of consensus. The company saw robust commercial sales growth and expanded its global footprint with 175 new stores, alongside significant share repurchases.

items.title: US Services Activity Surge to 5-Year High: S&P Global
items.summary: The S&P Global US Services PMI reached 58.7 in September 2026, marking its strongest expansion in over five years, driven by a surge in new orders and employment growth. This increase occurred despite rising input costs, primarily due to fuel price hikes from the war in Iran. However, future business confidence remains tempered by cost-of-living concerns.

items.title: Do New Community Openings Change The Bull Case For Century Communities (CCS)?
items.summary: Century Communities (CCS) recently announced several new community openings across multiple states, expanding its footprint, especially in the entry-level housing market. This expansion aims to address affordability and demand pressures, with a notable development being Mirabella near West Houston, which will add over 1,100 homesites. While analysts have mixed views on the impact of these new communities on Century Communities' financial outlook, the company's focus remains on growing its community count and managing existing pressures from elevated mortgage rates and cost inflation.

items.title: Delta Air Lines stock gains 1.72 percent as earnings near
items.summary: Delta Air Lines stock saw a 1.72 percent gain, closing at USD 83.92 on September 22, 2026, ahead of its next earnings release. The airline reported quarterly revenue of USD 17.67 billion, exceeding analyst expectations, with adjusted earnings per share of USD 1.56. Lower oil prices are seen as a positive factor for airline stocks, easing cost pressures for companies like Delta.

items.title: Will Dollar Tree's Strategic Initiatives and Store Expansions Aid?
items.summary: Dollar Tree (DLTR) is strengthening its business through strategic initiatives including assortment expansion, multi-price penetration, and store improvements. The company reported a 7% year-over-year increase in net sales and raised its fiscal 2026 outlook. Dollar Tree's stock has outperformed the industry, and its valuation and future earnings estimates appear favorable, earning it a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy).

items.title: Paychex stock slumps after Q1 earnings beat; earnings, revenue guidance unchanged (PAYX:NASDAQ)
items.summary: Paychex stock experienced a 7.4% decline despite beating Q1 earnings consensus, as total expenses exceeded expectations, leading to a miss in adjusted EBITDA. The company reaffirmed its full-year earnings and revenue guidance, but raised outlooks for PEO/insurance revenue growth and interest on funds held for clients. While PEO and insurance solution revenue growth accelerated, management solutions and interest on funds held for clients showed slowing year-over-year growth rates.

items.title: Paychex Inc Stock (PAYX) Moved Down by 7.07% on Sep 23: What Signal Does It Send?
items.summary: Paychex Inc (PAYX) stock fell by 7.07% despite reporting in-line revenue and an earnings beat for Q1 FY2027, primarily due to modest softness in its core Management Solutions segment and management's decision to maintain full-year guidance instead of raising it. Technical indicators show sell signals and oversold conditions, reflecting investor disappointment over valuation sensitivities and lack of organic growth acceleration expectations. The company's profitability also relied heavily on client float income and expense discipline rather than revenue outperformance.

items.title: Moody's (MCO) Draws Growth Attention, Is The Stock Fully Valued?
items.summary: Moody's (MCO) is back in focus due to strong earnings estimates and operational efficiency, despite recent share price dips. While Simply Wall St's narrative suggests it's approximately fairly valued at $473.36, a different view based on P/E ratio indicates potential overvaluation compared to its fair ratio and peers. Investors are encouraged to review underlying data to weigh the mixed signals regarding its valuation and risk.

items.title: Starbucks stock slips 1.08 percent as Q3 margins widen
items.summary: Starbucks stock decreased by 1.08% despite reporting strong Q3 FY2026 results. The company's adjusted EPS beat consensus estimates by 28.8%, and global comparable sales rose by 7.9%. Management also raised its fiscal 2026 adjusted EPS guidance, indicating robust operational performance even as the stock trades below its yearly high.

items.title: Installed Building Products stock weighs Q2 gains against housing strain
items.summary: Installed Building Products (IBP) reported strong Q2 2026 financial results, with revenues up 2.3% year-over-year to $777.8 million and adjusted EPS of $2.91, significantly beating analyst consensus. Despite a 6% decline in residential same-branch sales, the company saw a 10% increase in commercial same-branch sales, indicating a shift in market dynamics. IBP's stock traded at $209.90, above its 52-week low, with analysts giving it a consensus "Hold" rating.
